ideas.title: Investigating the ICE Shooting Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ICE shooting investigation and the claims of a cover-up by Minnesota officials.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the ICE shooting?
Is there evidence of a cover-up?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale cover-up, and I recommend investigating further to see if there are any connections between the FBI and ICE.

ideas.title: Uncovering Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged daycare fraud in Minnesota and the doubts surrounding the investigation.
questions: What is the scope of the daycare fraud?
Is there evidence of wrongdoing by Governor Walz's office?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud, and I recommend investigating further to see if there are any connections between the Governor's office and the daycare fraud.
